title: Naturality of own-stage epsilon on the actual coefficient quotient
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbb Q_\ell$, and an isomorphism $g:X\to Y$ of schemes with $\ell$ invertible, with stalk-unit proofs $h_X,h_Y$. For each finite coefficient field $E$ in $\Omega$ let $S_E$ be an IsomorphismFieldTransportStage for $g$ as defined in [def-pod-isomorphism-field-transport-clauses]. Assume isomorphismFieldTransportRationalScalarLaw for every $E\subseteq L$. Write $F_g,F_{g^{-1}}$ for the actual commonStageDerivedPullback functors of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let $e_P:F_{g^{-1}}F_g(P)\simeq P$ be any family of object isomorphisms whose hom at each pair $P=(E,K)$ is heterogeneously equal to the image of $(S_E).rationalEpsilon_K$ under the actual inclusion of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Then for every arrow $f:P\to Q$, $(F_g\mathbin{\ggg}F_{g^{-1}})(f)\,e_Q=e_P f$. No inverse stage family or shift data beyond that already inside $S_E$ is assumed.

proof.text: Transport the given rational inverse/scalar law across the published operationStageTransitionIso on source and target. Naturality of these transition identifications and cancellation of their inverse components give the compatibility square for the two actual stage-system morphisms.

The normalized comparison components identify each stage-system descent with the prescribed commonStageDerivedPullback by its unique object and arrow characterization. Use the transported scalar square to construct a compatible Morphism.Hom from the composite to the identity.

Descend this transformation. Its components are the inclusions of the finite epsilon isomorphisms, so NatIso.ofComponents supplies an isomorphism for the composite descended functor. The prescribed component equality identifies its hom with the supplied e at each pair. Its naturality is the desired equation.

lean.statement:
theorem isomorphismFieldTransportEpsilonNaturality
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    (S : ∀ E : Index l Ω,
      IsomorphismFieldTransportStage l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g hX hY)
    (hS : ∀ (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L),
      isomorphismFieldTransportRationalScalarLaw l
        (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)
        (coefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) g hX hY (S E) (S L))
    (e : ∀ P : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y,
      (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω g ⋙ commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω (inv g)).obj P ≅ P)
    (he : ∀ P : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y,
      HEq (e P).hom
        ((inclusion (Y := Y) P.stage).map ((S P.stage).rationalEpsilon.hom.app P.obj))) :
    ∀ (P Q : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Y) (f : P ⟶ Q),
      (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω g ⋙ commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω (inv g)).map f ≫
        (e Q).hom = (e P).hom ≫ f
